description:
Weread is a web content read-it-later app that allows users to save articles, blog posts, and other web content for a better reading experience.
Weread is and will be free to download and use. As it's open source and under a free license, you can even take the code and modify it!
• Android: Ready to use native app.
• Free to Use: This app is free to download and use!
• Open Source: Since this app is MIT-licensed, you can modify it!
